items.title: Every local subring of a field is dominated by a valuation ring with that fraction field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that every local subring of a field K is dominated by a valuation ring with fraction field K (statement lines 11966-11971). The proof does not invoke a general existence theorem for valuation rings: it orders local subrings by domination, applies Zorn's lemma after checking that unions of chains remain local subrings dominating their members, and then shows that a maximal element must have fraction field K by exhibiting, for an element outside the fraction field, an explicit strictly larger local subring in the transcendental and in the algebraic case (proof lines 11973-11997). Splitting the enlargement according to the nature of the chosen element is the content. H2.
